Release v1.4.1 (8 December 2019) |previous_update = [[Release v1.3]] |next_update = [[Release v1.5|Christmas 2019 Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Release v1.4''' was the sixteenth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 29th of November 2019. It added the [[Ace Pilot]] tower, a few balance changes, and later, the [[Platinum Crate]]. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''Release v1.4''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed three updates, the main Release v1.4.0 update (released 29 November 2019) and two minor updates, the Release v1.4.0a (released 30 November 2019) and the Release v1.4.1 (released 8 December 2019). ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Ace Pilot]] ===Maps=== :There were no new maps in '''Release v1.4.0''', but there was one in '''Release v1.4.1''': *[[Infernal Abyss]]
